summary: Iter43-fix24g testing: Bird.com as SMS provider (SmsBulk/Contacts/WaBulk) + dry-run sandbox for handler-suggestions. Backend pytest 11/11 PASS. Frontend verified live (SmsBulk dropdown shows '📡 Bird.com'; AdminHandlerSuggestions modal dry-run executes successfully with reply rendered).
